_comment: Template for `python3 scripts/fetch_packs.py --urls scripts/packs.example.json`. Use it when Pixabay/Vlipsy block automated downloads: open the clip in your browser, copy the direct media link (right-click → copy link/address of the file, or the cdn.pixabay.com / media.vlipsy.com URL), and paste it here. `kind` is audio|video, `dir` may point anywhere (defaults: audio → assets/sfx/vfx, video → assets/memes). Nothing here is downloaded by the app itself.
